english: Then I disagree with the third part of your reason above: it's not true that there exist many examples of things which are not qualities, but which are still either a quality of knowable things, or of something which is characteristic of knowable things. Suppose you do disagree. In that case, let's consider—one last time—qualities. There do too exist many examples of things which are not qualities, but which are still either a quality of knowable things, or of something which is characteristic of knowable things; Because the pair of a coffee table and a coffee cup would be one such example; and the pair of unchanging things and working things would be another. 10 Is It the Case That Something Which Is Neither A Quality of Unchanging Things Nor a Quality of Working Things, But Which Is Still Either A Quality of Coffee Cups Or a Quality of Coffee Tables, Cannot Be a Quality of Coffee Cups?
